ths.text: Erebos, the god of the dead, rules the Underworld, and he sends Athreos to fetch the oracle Daxos, but Lidia takes her son's place and is brought below.
The Silence of the Gods leaves him unable to receive souls, so eidolons and Returned build up, and he sends Tymaret to slaughter the Returned who escape.
When Elspeth tests him he shows her an illusion of family life, which she breaks before entering Nyx, and later she asks him to trade her soul for Daxos's, and he agrees.

As the gods go to war after Heliod has Daxos purge Meletis, Erebos neglects the souls under his charge out of hatred of Heliod, and when Elspeth defeats Heliod he places him beneath a boulder and gives her safe passage home.

thb.text: Erebos is consumed by hatred of Heliod as war breaks out among the gods, and he begins to lose control of his realm's souls.

Tymaret tells him of Phenax's escape, and Erebos lets Tymaret leave the Underworld as a Returned to catch him, while he answers Pavios's prayer by promising that he and Thanasis can be together in his realm.
When Elspeth defeats Heliod, Erebos imprisons him in the Underworld and grants Elspeth life.
